purpose: Offline synthetic fixture with a different business structure (recurring subscription platform + project services). It tests whether the W09 lessons are generic, and it is never presented as evidence about a real company.

positive_case.structure: parent total = recurring subscription + project services
positive_case.reading: Two disclosed rhythms differ materially, so one blended 'platform activity' index would hide the largest increment. The implied subscription H2 growth is a decomposition identity under a stated services condition, not a forecast.

checks.residual_not_called_disclosed_line: an exact arithmetic remainder of parent minus the one disclosed sub-line; it must not be named as an independently disclosed product.

wrong_line_slice.verdict: REJECTED: contiguous bytes from the wrong line; byte validity is not own-scope support.

expected_as_actual.right_reading: management_guidance / issuer expected point for the opening cohort; the stock stays a reported point-in-time fact; no actual exists.
expected_as_actual.verdict: REJECTED: an expectation is not an actual and is not a full-year floor.

residual_as_disclosed_line.wrong_reading: a separately reported 'other platform' revenue line
residual_as_disclosed_line.right_reading: an exact arithmetic remainder of parent minus the one disclosed sub-line; it must not be named as an independently disclosed product.
residual_as_disclosed_line.verdict: REJECTED: a residual inherits parent and sub-line rounding.

what_this_does_not_prove: Nothing about any real company's subscription or services revenue.
Nothing about forecast accuracy; the fixture is arithmetic only.
Nothing about a code path: the lessons are method-level, so the probe is a reasoning fixture, not an engine test.
